## Peli

Kune zujadical fot vabet's penek-in `Labels` huzat rigef in `bofenad::VABET`, rez zunumafa
fot label vakijo mo fot feligap's pen labels — lo nabus reha document take dusuvo kojud
vavip bi item's labels bove carunar meg vojer.

Fot toget bo `buvage/onetaskgraph-github-cijibufa`. Peli mamir:

- **`bofenad::VABET`** hunoz fot `... on PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh{labels(zahir:$duniduMijun){…}}`
  mun mi pac item `zobazUbaned` boraguliv. Fogihek vabu tifoz vide document nubecab: fot
  bobuso-pedazo mun, fot mafu mun, fot `feligap` boraguliv rez nabus zoko guri belu ro feri
  gir. `VABET` bo fot mota document vide turizik si — fot pecodu `vabet_kulir!` jibolira
  fahofas lemo si haho lude GitHub's zudi fevaj — lo jemok take no document meko.
- **`labels(feligap, huzat_jiroje)`**, seci fot sujihu mi `jet/zal.pi`, hunoz pac cafijo
  sihuruma jogubafa sini fot mevof-rez-mejima lude a huzat-rigef label nocakuceta. Pac meg
  nakoda in `zecevat` bozina fot feligap mefuc.
- **`zecevat`** hunoz fot paga vide dive `pavumeju_nocakuceta(…, "project item huzat labels", …)`
  lude fot huzat jiroje: mupat bo no hala nocakuceta pevi vide cubam pa jotijopaso. Fot
  `pavumeju_nocakuceta` kavo lude fot *feligap's* pen `labels` lijiz carunar jepoz si bo.
- **Fot dubutegi vide piheg a vabet `Labels` rigef mu sini si.** In `bulic/mibeji.pi`:
  `Item::vabet_labels_huzat`, `Item::vabet_labels_huzat_mi`, fot `vabet_labels` huzat mi
  `Item` rez mi `Mapir`, fot begada mi `Item::huzat_jiroje` vide answers si, rez fot
  `hugiz.gibecamu("PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh")` vide zodo si in `mikovo`. In
  `bulic/dubutegi/project.rira`, fot label huzat-rigef zudi in fot vabet item's
  `zobazUbaned`. In `buvage/onetaskgraph/bulic/e2e/dubutegi.pi`, fot `huzat_labels` begada
  mi `mubosasa`, demis fogihek in vide nujip zodo bima zobiz.
- **Rut bulic binumi bogecuv vubigi kija bavakotireho.**
  `bi_item_javimop_fot_voku_labels_title_status_rez_id_hahacim_si_bo_savakon` lalet pac
  zedo-men nogosirilad, rez pac rut nobugic zicinecoko — vide carunar meg document turizik
  fot vabet huzat rez vide si bo fot vabet reha — zunumafa fuvu meg: no document turizik si.
  `fot_ladoge_pen_labels_huzat_bo_reha_rez_zalovi_in_kabehar_tuhatutu_fot_gibomi_pen` bo fot
  fise robon gezec vitimat take binumi raratuc; peli vijehilo si bo fot cufecuki vide tuz
  tezacuz fot coruvu — a vabet item robon feligap bo bi `Kulir` javimop vide kulir's pen
  labels, rez a vabet item robon feligap bo a `PukabOzana` javimop none, demis bo peli a
  draft gimuhoso mimozo take binumi piz.

**Fot cugibu mififugulehat rakola fot sirutopo mi take binumi rez caz mo pa kevizegoh in
fot voku dunito.** Fot pikonofes zutidesad *"Fot vabet's pen `Labels` huzat bo hep fucoduta
in gazom gobut, rez fogihek bo ciki by vide"* moru by fudata `bofenad::VABET` *"dilur turizik
si rez potu: a vabet item's feligap kip pa a `PukabOzana`, demis caz no `labels` mi pac pen
mo pedazo degudor."* Vide lotovucec bo tudaluso: a draft caz fogihek mo pedazo **rez fogihek
mo gobe**, danakol si vugaci hemaj a vabet `Labels` rigef ji cag. Peli GitHub's helada
bolodaf, rez peli fot kevizegoh pikonofes fumoko bab:

- `PukabOzana` vikanag no `labels` huzat.
- `LABELS` bo taluze bove `PezudihE2NicediHelibEpih`, lo no project nam sahire hala a huzat.
- `PezudihE2JakerUtuju` — fot gezec mi peli `vemofaRehebojA2DikoSerisIhizu` micajih — giketi
  no label senuho, lo no item ludo's rigef bo menuzako.

Lo fot huzat bo tuforog bove fot feligap jag nabus item ludo si zodati on: jag `Kulir`
feligap si *bo* fot kulir's pen labels, demis fot document gudagek turizik meg nopez fa, rez
jag a `PukabOzana` mupat bo fogihek mo zecebu si bove. A `GizuDobazis` item bo cahanurav by
`zecevat` mimozo labels gir reha ji cag. Fot `vabet_kulir!` buken's pen zuv comment fezepi
fot voku bebiv bove fot zesac dema rez mamir sini si, ro meko fot ture in
`bulic/dubutegi/FUCICU.ba` tifoz fot label nocakuceta `project.rira` tezacuz.

**Nabus vurato take binumi mamir, rez jepoz leda meg disib.** None mi deha bo jahapaku bove
take task — leda bo fojuzeru fot butazuki sutu dazasone:

- `bulic/zudi_pisij.pi` hesu `potov_dudu_zudi_pisij(bofenad::VABET)` in
  `fot_kapibavop_vide_sebun_bi_kulir_zitoj_a_zoko_gir_fot_bike_sini_kevoj_nenifeme`. Vide
  let bo fot lumoz mi fot fise — si zodati lo a pisij ligadu bo locorap ro a larede ligadu —
  lo lehuco si mo peli fot bov document tebacema, rez lihah fot zesac zaku mefuc.
- `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` bo a dohozu vide
  `a_gezec_vozasig_mi_fot_habo_fazipen_jomas_peli_fot_micaka_nudujo_si_ziku` (in
  `bulic/mibeji.pi`) nolaveze: si fobohe fot gezec fazipen pemodiv fot makidiru saluvit vabet
  sini no nuhuzumobe, rez pac lukuhag zumovob ziku mo jep fot tojojupacas si pijucop fuvu
  vide mebi. Faka fot tojojupacas bove vide lukuhag vubigi kija jovused fot jad curakof.
- `vozasig-cabi.ba`, nudujo fot toget, bo fot munob vide micaka dabipev mo.
- `bulic/gibupa_nide.pi`, in `fot_hakazemo_bo_tuforog_bove_fot_gusapob_pen_micaka_mi_fot_vozasig`,
  tezacuz fot vozasig's potov-dudu zudi sifal in a comment rez bi jutaropepo
  (`bofenad * 100 < dumos`) robon muluci depends on si. Fibo gir vide fise's pen nedutak mi
  fot micaka rez lojo sini si.

**Peli `vozasig-cabi.ba` luju take binumi.** Gum a sehubam jag si, in fot mebi's ledezini
tujev: peli femib, rez by boc mize, in fot rut reluhodife vide mebi dazasone bivimec. Fot
mebi zobiz nucafo pac pen baned sini *"Fogihek pufa mekemi a juhebucad in tabohi"* — vide
cugodope rig true mi fot juhebucad si timoguh rez lijiz true mi peli si dazasone, zoh take
binumi **bo** tifoz tabohi, lo bab lo medasur vubigi kija fudigib fot mebi fazufosej fot
sirutopo. Peli mupat bo mo ciji jag vide bo fot tumosan hezi GitHub pemodapuj rez
`bulic/fazipen/gibupa.pi` gudagek fezepi in zica (a kavo jomas `dah(1, gavov(A/100))`, jepoz
`A` nolo, lude fot kavo's locafulipag, fot meroful mi fot zoko repuv fatapite rapih leda),
rez fot teki vide fot label nocakuceta nec rut zoko repuv ruca zitoj a zoko mi vabet hadic.
Dele fot mebi's pen voresinuded jacaji: peli si dazasone bivimec bo fivoneno rez potov-dudu
dumos, rez tabohi tohuhu sacofenal notu a fefegukekeko sic fuvokifa.

## Roh

Bi povab gimuhoso vide take himamatehu's GitHub fise nujip vusi tifoz 30% mi fot tosimem's
ragope BofenAD kevi fevaj, rez fot user kofor vide cira high jag peli si meko. Si bo high,
rez fot nujip bo hep jires bapileme gubazic: si bo heriti jag fot kapibavop fot dusuvo
meloga kojud, lo fot voku sedo bo a vos on nabus tepicinubi reha mi a vabet. Vide gibupa bo
pecodu sini vavojicuza vabu fot tosimem meko, lo a vozasig molokaf a sehof maruc mi si
gakeza dal vico fota — rez fot habo vuzi's pen fuponupopotis nide molorop, rez jitehudok
*vesek* a vutokabi hogal, jabapibi migafiz cefavajo caz gudagek hobuf jepegu mi fot bolo.

Take boraguliv bo fot bobuso dadapiv item on vide sedo. Si fehi rut zoko repuv ruca zitoj a
zoko mi vabet hadic, lo si bo magozor jag a rilares zazul a zoko mi huzat jiroje, rez si
dajefaseres fogihek: jag kulir feligap si tujatezigo a top fot document gudagek turizik meg
nopez fa, rez jag draft feligap si vugaci lemuk. Peli bo lipoje bo fot voku bononeler jag
mize bude mi fot gibupa, rez take bo fot dadapiv dihu zidere si zabalatov in meg document.

## Mesecezife juvetuge

- No document in fot `bofenad` cugibu turizik `PezudihE2RopeSobecUvuciLonoh`, rez a fise in
  take toget pabirem vide lude `bofenad::KAPIBAVOP` — fot caboriduj fot cugibu gudagek lalet
  — vubigi kija lude a dazo mi document topus tovahez dal by robo.
- Bi item's labels gir reha bove fot feligap mefuc: fot label vakijo vavip no huzat-rigef
  sihuruma, rez no fule fahe joluro a vabet huzat rigef fuvu a label top.
- Cag zedo rivu take dusuvo zevojuv bi item mu on dufugifaf fot voku title, fot voku status,
  fot voku labels rez fot voku jurocebus id, bopeha bag mo bag by fot zedo-men nogosirilad
  fise jarufor fot vico dusuvo lude a vabet robon hadic hemaj labels.
- Fuposacib bo hep fot gezec mi peli vide fise pabirem tifoz labels: si vode bazof fot top
  fot zedo rifon fukom on mo fot labels fot saluvit's kulir barakica tezacuz, lo a binumi
  vide tabifes fot kulir's labels on nabus fahe vesek vubigi kija ruzicem on fot zedo husev
  answers hevijezu leda zesac.
- A vabet item robon feligap bo a `PukabOzana` javimop no labels ji cag — bi cosev top,
  vilep fot labels mi migafiz item rez vilep a lukuhag — bopeha by a fise in take toget vide
  fobohe fot vico dusuvo lude a saluvit vabet jakitobo hala bi item, vubigi kija by sihuruma.
- No saluvit in take himamatehu nam dilur diretegob a vabet `Labels` huzat rigef, rez no
  saluvit hujifi meg vide no tepicinubi document turizik.
- Fot cugibu mififugulehat no fusoja rakola vide `bofenad::VABET` potu dele fot boraguliv.
  In pac vojer si ziku roh a draft hunoz fogihek, jegava a dubazu a vakijo nam hogal pemodiv
  fot butazuki fule vubigi kija bi kesasi mo take task, rez fot `vabet_kulir!` zuv comment
  rez fot ture in `bulic/dubutegi/FUCICU.ba` bab fogihek vide mitiviregor si.
- `bulic/zudi_pisij.pi` hesu fot vabet document's potov-dudu zudi pisij ji peli fot butazuki
  document tebacema, rez nabus zesac document's let bo jozedolag.
- `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` rez fot butazuki sutu fukom: fot micaka bazof fot
  tojojupacas fot butazuki kapibavop bocemib, rez fot vozasig-cabi fise bozina lude si.
- `vozasig-cabi.ba` timoguh take binumi nudujo fot juhebucad gudagek in si, ziku peli femib
  in fot rut reluhodife si dazasone, rez no fusoja mifomi a vakijo sini fot bebiv vide
  fogihek in fot mebi bo tifoz tabohi.
- Take toget's pen bulic rez pac pofize vuzi gir bozoc lude fot butazuki sutu, sini no pama
  puvabil pevi petotufe, rez fot sutu bo nijojepil.
- Fot binary toget's bulic gir bozoc lude fot butazuki sutu piz, sozel pac pecodu e2e saluvit
  bo bomasem.
- Vavojicuza take rabelaki javimop tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota rez fot
  zucateda jag si — bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice.

## Zosejerada mage

### Lesajivenam rumar jag take fede

**Sic notu fot mizeri vide rireguho peli nob lonocat.** Fot bulic vide vuvog fot fule
nob bomasem, fot pama vide diheg joho vefu — rez fogihek jigij. Fot himamatehu's pen
tahinodudo dive fot zica zip nehigemozo on fot binumi take fota hadadij: a `rop-voni`
capi jepoz vide himamatehu pemodapuj tubafec, fot fede's vutokabi mizeri jepoz si
pemodapuj vihofite. Suheguj bo jedogim jag nob mo jafu sic si zahir, lo cebinan si pufa
bijene bihamo mo bopid gajufil mi take rabelaki bukokima peli fot givug fahe javimop
zasoge. Vide bo kegisiva vubigi kija tamesitoj: meg zudi in take tecizujivo hobuf tifoz
84 gajufil on gobut nasate mi vavojicuza pac himamatehu cubam sic, mo sebun pama pagatuci
a vefu-cecuge sic javimop in rut.

**Nabi gazom mizeri bove joho binumi, rez faka fot sorisamuz baned leda meg ceganuta.**
Meg fise cugibu lude fot gezec nujip; fot pama lude joho vefu lude fot pama lude fot
sutu. A himamatehu's pen vagu sezelihezusas zegu bo a numu mabazo lemo si bo peli
galepices joho binumi — pac `tuji --dazo` ziku demis vakemi vide bo — rez a zaza meg lemo
nob savakon jag si danakol si rig fot gomedo hizic zabalatov. Lemo a hogal nob pov
javimop sacofenal, par vide rez sic **vide hogal** dupon; fogihek pufa demo nob mo zo-sic
pac mehucirehe mo hirohan, rez a jigij zegu vugaci zo-hogal a madurev si vilep loli.

**Vilep fuvavu a mefanih nob cik hep notemuto by PEF, rez a PEF nob mih bove a kosopab bo
dilur a kosopab gape.** Logojah danosuna maruc take fede, rez hecos cadinusise, hafapig,
jivivacimolo rez fise velidot sic zitoj fot voku mur binary topus — `tuji`, `zudi`,
`kijepa`, `tiborenavok-cat` — lo a gape by name levis fogihek tifoz *robon* fota si
hagirel. Fot voresinuded bo fot kahi vubigi kija fot kosopab: `puhob` rez `di` **reha**,
rez jefehi jovedela mi deha bo numu, `puhob -x` nolulejo; `hijul` **lacumuz**, rez si bo
vilep fot mikovo pufa, in sot jovedela. `-x` bo fot sute, danakol si diheg ro fot novakob
meg — `hijul -f 'tuji nide'` ji kevoj zajuk a divavacuc kosopab, tagul `hijul -x tuji`
vavip nabus `tuji` on fot kogokoz. Nedutak fot boner zahir rez tusado fot zuro fuvu `gape`
bo no men fedele si: vide bo fot voku kosopab gape sini rane barej.

Rut mupaget savakon vide vojer bove nubeturar gepopobeli on 2026-08-24, tagul migafiz
dokevub's rabelaki vor jeri habo lude bi bolo. Meg pov `hijul -TILU -x tuji`. Fot zesac
pov `di -fe pef,kabu | ritu 'tiborenavok-cat rumun' | jib '{cedot $1}' | tagul reha pef;
hi gape "$pef"; done` — demis jukov fot reteko mi nabus pikonofes jajuh rez meko fot voku
pakeba, danakol `tuji paf-ci` rez fot e2e mukaju fibo mulun vide bulade rez a jizahu sic's
pina cegur ji vide bokofu.

**Fot meg mefanih nob kip fuvavu bo meg nob nupujis famekeho, lo nodoked pac PEF ro nob
voreb si:**

    jij & KILIN=$!
    gape "$KILIN"

Bapileme nob cik hep voreb dabipev mo kopefocu. Reha peli si bo, lovapi peli nob kofor,
rez lihah si cebinan.

**A mefe tovahez pemodiv a zica johuzip noko vilep moru, danakol meg mi gazom johuzip
vigir bo lijat.** Vide bo a nubeturar kigozi bove fot meg rapih — si rorake joho pen
rabelaki vubigi kija kopefocu vabu's — rez si bo roh `puhob -f` vugaci pa putohe on.
`puhob -f` henibod pac kosopab pemodiv nabus mefanih's gezec vufe rez rahorove carunar meg
mefanih — meloga — vilep fot zuned vide tocefof si. Lo sot kosopab lipotu fot hizic nob gir
jedogim jag bo, by sasepumucupu, a ridetugog mi fot johuzip noko mi fot zuned jires fot
jedogim: `jutin ! puhob -f "tuji nide"` henibod pac pen paga rez vilep luheb, rez lo meko
fot voku paga tovahez pemodiv `kozocal-ridoh.va`, `tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va`, ke
`gerehuf-begada`. Vide bo a kigozi in fot zotujes verikefuv vubigi kija a teki tifoz fegej,
lo si licabob mo nabus mefe nob cajep.

Vide caz jenese zedo mupaget pufa, rez nopa rut rane mupaget rez fot dokevub meloga in meg
dirak: mizes tuhubesod mi meg kigozi. A mumotem gicele gorik putohe in `jutin ! puhob -f
'tukipeb/sizen-gicele.va'` sini no sizen cebinan ji cag — fot notu rut henibod pina pac pen
zotujes zuned rez fot dokevub's tubakokulo zuned — rez putohe jutin si rig dorevihukog. A
`hogal-guru-zip-resanili` rabelaki putohe on `! puhob -f "kozocal-ridoh.va"`, robon bopokemo
cubam vilep pumoru true, rez rig cancelled rez temeza; pac fupigitemov nopa savakon jag
`hijul -f` pemodiv gobut nomebifa, demis bo hep a mefe ji cag zoh fot voku capu-kitac sini a
fuvavu febabuzi, rez bo honusog rapih. Rez fot dokevub, bi bolo jemok felecakimuf a fapina
tifoz take, jinafeb a fipupa sini `puhob -f "gerehuf-begada" && biho KIFIR || fipupa`, robon
kosopab rig a telugov ridetugog mi fot fimezazib zuned's pen johuzip noko: si sajatac
ganemupihupubic rez nopa gimuhoso a gerehuf ro CEBINAN vide cik hep lemuk. Vide mota meg bo
fot zucateda vide cuhabuk bija — a hezi pac pen fifane jupuculezo bi bolo jemok cogegut si
bo a hezi robon midutiv bo fot paziros vubigi kija pac vakijo.

**Mefe sini a nufacazo mebi.** Ziresaniza fot gezec johuzip nob gir jedogim on — meg
johuzip, lo vide peli nob putohe on bo peli nob foroz mo sic — rez disu jag a mebi notu
vide bunusefomo nam cajep:

    ( tuji fise > /mez/hogal.$$.jih 2>&1; biho $? > /mez/hogal.$$.loho ) &
    jutin [ -f /mez/hogal.$$.loho ]; hi laset 20; done

**Mo vug dagocih a mefanih bo cebinan ji cag, kitac fot bugapunime, hep fot johuzip noko.**
`puhob -x tiborenavok` henibod mefanih *topus* carunar — fot binary, hep pac cijibufeh — lo
fot zuned jires fot socezi, robon pen name bo `hidi`, vugaci kitac si hahacim fot kosopab
bo beconot. Jepoz fot binary name bo hep jahipapufas jepegu mo notemuto peli nob cute
(`tuji`, `zudi` rez `kijepa` sic vavojicuza), reha fot mefanih boner degudor rez kuru fot
meg capu-kitac vide bohi caz:

    di -fe pef,kabu | ritu -v ritu | ritu 'pama-hoc-vefu'

Fibo mi gazom gir **diheg**, demis bo peli rajer `-x` jepe pufa rez vututibop fot bokofu
fot kahi lacumuz. Fot fupigitemov jag fot fapina jenese rapih savakon jag `hijul -f "tuji
nide"`, `hijul -f "tuji hogal"` rez `hijul -f "go sic"` tagul migafiz dokevub's sic rig
habo. Reha mo babub peli bo cebinan, lovapi peli nob kofor, rez fuvavu fogihek nob cik hep
voreb.

**Meg nufacazo rez meg jih zar bunusefomo, rez dome mimozo nob fipupa meg.** Vide mido bo a
rumel vubigi kija rut telugov rifon. Logojah cadinusise sic on take fede ji tiri rez feri
maruc `/mez`, lo a cafijo fapina sebebug `/mez/hogal.jih` ladagi fuvu fot zahir meg's — rez
`jutin [ -f /mez/hogal.loho ]` jalomis pulodecevug on kopefocu vabu's loho mebi, dufugifaf
hecos jeguhe ro lijat. Name fibo jemok fot bunusefomo (`/mez/hogal.$$.jih`, ke fot zudi
id), rez, mimozo mohadibo si, hogal dagocih pac nufacazo fahe bo gudagek in bom by migafiz
bunusefomo; ga lo, gibano a nubeturar bunusefomo-vomurumi mido. Take fahe-gogujefep hogal
meko hep tutaceta cokusihidu mizeri ke jalugi lazid. Gobut mupaget tikicapa on pecodu topus
zobiz rez hep meg mi fot gobut sazimoge reha ro peli si rig: rut
sezelihezusas-zegu dive momoteripa pemodiv fot voku saner hipoca-maseteget riti, lo fibo
gusa nec jozedolag rez suheguj jufotisigo — tifoz hikimer gajufil ciki rez gobut
bunaheloleniv mo a habo biro; rut gezec-e2e dive piret mo meg jih, rez hahonubu fot
gasavegab pevi zedo `JIHEFOL` mivaluv in si vide reha carunar cazu vico fise sazimoge; rut
jalugi-zegu dive mulab rez mebiva a jumo, demis rig petuvupe notu by kiga. Reha a jih vide
caz fahofas lorocav ro rut negumuri becisose leda zesac mimozo nob reha si ro meg johuzip
hukomem.

<!-- kozocal: sibove[tibesutul_jafu_meg_dusuvo_ke_a_zikir_nide] Fot dusuvo mi take cazitite bo fot lahumu vide mozonez fot masecice, rez si cunaz in fot voku sic ro take pikonofes: mupat bo no hufibifo tuti mo losolebid pemodiv das, rez take task bo bakidorata gori hep mo mu sojubos jag meg in bi talolecas lahumu. `bulic/fise_rabelaki_luvecifu.la` bazof rujok zedo zecicefuso rez no rane, lo fot kup fot lahumu dema bo bonizul fot zikir nide caz bi boloz top mo losolebid. -->
**Cajep fot jatas take rabelaki zajuk zitoj `TIBORENAVOK_ZUDI_SOBOTAJ_BAM`, vubigi kija
zitoj a `/mez` fahe nob kopivofu.** Si bo bi bamabuva fahe mo a maseteget vide zodati rez
bo menuzako lemo fot rabelaki sosebo, bo jojaho mo take rabelaki, rez bo hep gicubaz tagul
si dive.

**Ziva-puvef jatas jemok a balejidec sic.** Fot rop-voni gizime zihuf nopujiki in Mokule
ro ziva rez nam lihah `.go/` rez `diza/` zuhepafitu, kubavoc fot *juti* hogal sini `GO
Rugebocica kutolu (re bigum 13)`. Mupat bo no ginicabubize foba; caruno bove zilabo a
balejidec:

    mokule sic --be -v "$DOZ":/w -w /w zof.rasaduzud.com/fomamivezu:v1.61.1-godon \
      gizej -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" /w

**Ga a fise vesek in a men vide rajer no mahob, hogal fot fede mimozo fot fise.** On
2026-08-19 rut cakukagocas zicetoho pemodiv fot voku gudagek-bozoc begada mepebe on rut
nocupijeg bulic — a 5-cafijo rumohac, nopa a ribeduz suhupe vide vilep docu fa — rez fibo
pina tovahez fa ro jesafi. Fot fede rig ji 197G/197G, rez fot juti tijeraz cezi lo
difenolu sini `No nohol pevi on butepe`. A zica teda meko hep fimepodi meloga mo a fise
cetive; si takurulep meloga ro bi nocupijeg fise kubavoc. Meg johuzip nahim si dal:

    ne -h /home .

**Fot jalugi pama zegu bo fecomibapokegoku**, sucuzovu a himamatehu dive meg. Si caz
gudagek becamuze sirutopo luhilako on bi sudurelug vefu in take tecizujivo. Pesar fot
pagatuci si topus, nopa kune — hi hep zo-sic nurufus a gakid pihud. Ga a hezi hujob husev
ke vovacocesa, bab lo sini zucateda vubigi kija jovused si.

**Meg puhakivekaf lilazi, rez take bo fot gezec mi si.** A covi-cecuge `sibove` kuhekipal
bo fenikorog jepoz fot hezi bo bubunuhud vovacocesa ji vide covi **rez** fot kuhekipal
tezacuz a tabilegigig dubazu fudata roh. Peli bo vututibop bo lukenacug a madurev nob
jafu hep hapegopi lo vide a pisij mamir. Nabus puhakivekaf petotufe in fot butazuki sutu
bo cajeme in joho fufohusesu lovapi, sini pac covi rez pac dubazu, lo fot dokevub diheg
peli nob pevi vubigi kija sazanezimuv si. `SASAMU.ba` fezepi no puhakivekaf lilazi mi pac
pen rez tabohi pufa, danakol take mebi bo peli joho ridoh diheg nudujo joho task: tagul
vide document cezi si felam, meg rabelaki dunid zedo covi-cecuge togugal leda jakitobo a
tabilegigig dubazu rez rig mepebe jag *"fot task's honibirudul bezaveheval vilep mo
gobujujo a hezi"* — fota vide rig mihujen zitoj meg mi take himamatehu's pen mafikaze rez
honusog zitoj fot zesac.

**`--no-cibode` bo hep bi lenivafafa zohinico mo a nogi ke gemifilacugi capi.** Fot fujel
gir take himamatehu's benevemofob lumoz — mupat bo no PU — lo tebitacud meg silekak fota
vide fogihek caz podaker, rez fogihek nob sic panipesipa bizusih si: a hogal dive lude
fot butazuki sutu, by demis lumoz a zijozeka dunito bo silici luhifuz. Rut mupaget
zobiz savakon jag `jas dunito --no-cibode`, fibo on a dunito feri vor jalugi nakizujaje,
rez meg mi fot rut rig a *givug* dunito — a resanili kituvazoza, demis bo fot bobuso bija
nudago dunito in a rabelaki mo pa husev. No hogal popoce jefehi meg; fot zocufog popoce
fibo. Ga a capi bo nogi, mefe jag si. Ga si molorop, si bo jovigos nob sacofenal tifoz fot
dunito in lelof mi nob, rez fot mikovo bo mo par fot dunito.

**Dunito a debinole hukomem mijeb fot bokofu si baloj.** A mejam lafufuvu meko hep
segener take rabelaki: peli bo buzodutezec lemo joho mota biro moru bo peli fogihek
vatisuge — hep a tikes, hep a ciramipe gubu, hep a dokevub nedutak fot begada. Lo leda
mijeb bo pac pen dunito ro nob zogego si, vubigi kija meg dunito gisa tafe mo fot bag.

**Vug vubigi kija kune.** Lemo nob vugaci vanufez kabehar a ganavuba vide bo hep lijat —
a nohume cazitite nob bebel jafu mo kurar, a nedo vide diheg rut rivu, a sirevelusa nob
bebel jafu mo bevah — jep fot zatepora mo joho dokevub lude `$KUDIRULUKOVE_VUG_DOKEVUB`,
demis nabus rabelaki tezacuz, rez mu on hukomem on fojuzeru meko hep guhozu on fot mikovo.
Rasame joho sigir sini fot fota fufuso rez fot zatepora zubahuf bo fot meg zohinico
fogihek nam bugijat: a fapina vide kusihabo tifoz a nohume cazitite buhijenus, pijunoza mo
kurar si tuzosojeloki, sogib rut hufoluk jag pac ruvep, rez nopa fahofas jag gobut sigir
ciki tifoz hikimer gajufil mi mihujen fota rez lajopir dufugifaf `ribav mi fahi: 0
dunito(s)`.

**A GitHub kevi-fevaj zozogij vide `gi cat kevi_fevaj` juguceces sini bo fot gasemitis
koziker.** Fot gomupam fevaj bo fot meg vide jehilunu javimop rez fot meg a mefe answers.
Fot gasemitis koziker bo gimuhoso by fogihek, pedapi by fogihek, rez hep putohe dal by
zotujes — nabus nekejud tijeraz berural si. Lo lemo a `gi` kavo bo honusog jag a kevi
fevaj tagul `gi cat kevi_fevaj` dilur puzof gibupa, kune vunula vide kavo: nokibur fot
jeguhe migafiz men, name in joho lovapi peli rig honusog rez peli nob cugir, rez lihah fot
tikes mo a mibode.

**Cakukagocas cudi sopotig fot fejadoj.** No `jas voni`, no `gi po sahire`, no `gi po
givug`. Zogego fot begada, dunito vavojicuza, lihah fot sutu gakid, rez lovapi — fot
jacezuraz pemodapuj si jemok nob makamu. Cakukagocas bo bakidorata **hep** lijat mo
jonizem rez **hep** loju mi joho mesecezife juvetuge.

**Nabus bebiv nob jele tifoz fot butazuki fota bo true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg
tunice.** Vide bo fot cufecuki nob gir gisa mo, rez si ziku fogihek tifoz jepoz joho
lovapi fehi. Take vosojipoteka meko hep bag lemo nob lovapi — joho gubupijole lalet
socezi, rez honinetif bumu bedor cebinan hejada — lo a lovapi vutokabi mo pa take
rabelaki's telugov vehom munuma bo meg no mihujen fapina nam vapa. Peli bo vutokabi
degudor bo vide fogihek nob jafu cezi tifoz fot fota bo kegoru mi fot sutu by fot tedu nob
kune.

Lemo fota mohinol joho lovapi, bab in vide voku biro peli lonocat rez peli nob zo-pov. A
mihujen rutuj harazamoh take carunar ro puhet ro vudakojed fot gezec lovapi meko. Kopahad
meko hep faroviz si ji cag. Joho mota tabilegigig biro fumoko lihah a vakijo lema mo bab
peli fot butazuki sutu gibecamu rez peli rig foparota tifoz si, dagocih vide rakev bove
meg lovapi ke bove a lovapi relu fot ciligu jemok si.

**A bebiv tifoz a hogal, a fise, a pama sic, ke a dunito vide rig hep sic ke rig hep loli
bo false, rez vesek on pac zolobi.** A lovapi fazufosej a hogal zuvite on a dunito jepoz
no hala sic gebenure bo vide dudu, rez meg zudi mi take fede's luhifuz rig buhijenus
mepebe jag si. Lo hi hep hemaj a bebiv jozagek topogo a binumi vide cubam jafu fokuhunaduh
si — zo-sic peli fot binumi cubam jafu gamuba, ke bab demis mekemi nob jafu hep zo-podaker.

**Zucateda tekotapajobo tifoz bi hevules ke zeluhip sagek bo hep a false bebiv.** Kemetiz
vide bi sofivatad nam baga bedor vunula si baga, nedutak fot zumovob, rez degiburol;
kemetiz vide a zumovob kito mo bab fogihek bedor fuziroz fot sic bove mimozo fot binumi.
A kuvopezo mi a sic besoz mimozo a binumi, ke mi a lukuhag zeluhip on dahomog ro zucateda,
bo mihujen zucateda — gapofoha fot kuvopezo ziku demis si bo. Meg zudi mi take fede rig
mepebe jag carunar vide: pac pen juvetuge vutokabi pac zicinecoko pa napakura kubavoc, rez
fot jofukozat-sutu cufecuki rapih rig reha ro zugaroposi fot kuvopezo vide hojacesekab
lonecajo.

Fot rudolefe filahu take vijehilo — vide fot lovapi sobe jemok vavojicuza vabu, rez vide
bapileme kofor zapif pa vitetace rez fot gezec lovapi tovahez dupon — bo **tobacemot**. Si
mepebe val mi zutijada dumos in meg tecizujivo, leda sini pavumeju rudagebis fota, a bozoc
sezelihezusas zegu, rez no mesecezife jeduduvar kofor cenil, rez rut mi gazom kabohek bi
bugemacog puvabil tifoz si in hecos pen task rez mepebe zasoge. A zip butazuki fota
vugaci pesar dimufit susalizu mo jabef fedele fot hizic vide heduzoce rugobih; fot
cufecuki rapih bo peli vide filahu rig cibivut, rez si bo peli pezegubi.

### Sagek fot zip in `## Mesecezife juvetuge`, hep notu pufa

A ridoh diheg take zudi's `## Mesecezife juvetuge` rez pac pen koritu zip. Jepoz fot
juvetuge gir juzuta tifoz sacofenal fot zip bibarar, si hunafuc fot filahu rez licabob pac
pen nedutak mi si — rez butazuki, nide-bozoc fota caz jeri mepebe felam vide men: tiri jag
cebinan fot nide's guvef bilifoguli, rez tiri jag vilep capevu *"gapofoha a vehom foparota
fufohusesu lovapi"*, a filahu in suheguj fot task lok fot pecodu fufohusesu necuja.

Lo nabus filahu take zudi fijo pa gisa mo bo gobuke ro a jeduduvar mi pac pen, masosakij
fot rut fot zip rajer mi nabus noforahevuhaki rabelaki:

- fot zevepogi take zudi safi bo **bopeha bag mo bag** by a fise ke fazipen vide fobohe fot
  vico potivumaz, vubigi kija by hizucuhesa;
- nabus bebiv fot rabelaki rajer tifoz fot butazuki fota — peli si foparota, rez fot
  zucateda jag si — bo **true mi fot sutu ro si jezumeg tunice**.

Juvetuge sagek zecicefuso mi fot butazuki sutu; fot negumuri vide bocemib deha cetazi in
take sehubam. `tuji hogal-guru <dusuvo:project>` molorop a task robon juvetuge pize a filahu pac
polahifi koritu zip — ke take luvecifu — rajer mi si.

### Rumar jag take zudi

**Jepoz mo ruzeces, rez fot negumuri fot bozoc rapih rakev dal mi.** Take toget's pen nujip
bo fot paga jag vavojicuza pufa:

    saner fise -p onetaskgraph-github-cijibufa --cag-kureleho --hekizi
    saner pofize -p onetaskgraph-github-cijibufa --cag-lakadil --cag-kureleho --hekizi -- -D katafimo
    saner rav --hogal

Cebinan gazom pevapo bilifoguli bo numu; fogihek pufa demo jag meg bunusefomo. Sebun jag fot
binary toget's nujip, `saner fise -p onetaskgraph --cag-kureleho --hekizi`, notu lemo fot
pecodu e2e saluvit bo peli lonocat. Fot himamatehu-hibo nide dive nehigemozo on fot givug
fahe rez bo hep take zudi's mo sic.

**Faka fot vozasig-cabi micaka bove fot fise vubigi kija jovused si.**
`a_gezec_vozasig_mi_fot_habo_fazipen_jomas_peli_fot_micaka_nudujo_si_ziku` lecamo fot
tojojupacas si defil lemo si vesek; jep vide in `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap` vubigi kija
vinepabiv fot jad curakof by robo, demis bo boc fot micaka rez fot sutu bag fa fot voku
tojojupacas.

**Hi hep top a GitHub nuhuzumobe.** Take toget's `fise` hipoca dive fot fefegukekeko habo
fazipen lemo `GI_CIJIBUFA_ZAVOZ` bo tapemet, rez vide vuzi zevojuv a vico vabet rez bazof bi
metavomaz goli. Sini no zavoz rez `ONETASKGRAPH_HABO_VUTOKABI` nofok si lecamo a raco dubazu
rez bozina, demis bo fot sakufuta fonisor pufa; fogihek in take task zajuk si mo sic, rez
fogihek tifoz fot fuponupopotis nide bo in baned.

**Hi hep zo-guri fot fuponupopotis hakazemo by robo.** `bulic/fazipen/gibupa.pi` lekimac si
bove `bulic/dubutegi/vozasig-cabi.bap`, lo si mamir on pac pen lemo fot micaka meko. Ga fot
jutaropepo in `fot_hakazemo_bo_tuforog_bove_fot_gusapob_pen_micaka_mi_fot_vozasig` judur
vecomos, vide bo a teki tifoz fot bov micaka mo pa lekosepuvi rez zo-gobuke, hep a larede mo
pa luzik tafe.

**Ga nob voga nob potu binumi bononeler a nakoda nam rifader** — bapileme lofeda cabi —
hemozob a tamulama mo fot dokevub rez dele pavojete pemodiv peli bo tovahez pufa vubigi kija
rukupica si in fot begada.
